title: SKAB run other/10
note: Real data from the SKAB pump rig. The shaded band is the fault labelled by SKAB.

alerts.title: Fluid temperature sensor looks faulty: erratic signal (loose contact or interference)
reasons: The reading became erratic (3.8x normal variability, jumps 3.8x the largest healthy step).
The related motor temperature signal stayed calm, which a real machine change would rarely allow.
alerts.cause: Instrument problem, not the machine: wiring, connector, power or calibration.
alerts.action: Check the fluid temperature transmitter and its wiring before sending mechanical maintenance. Treat its readings as unreliable until it is checked.
alerts.truth: Overlaps a fault labelled in SKAB.
